category_title: Year 7 pupils who respond to public reprimands by staying quiet and to stamps by working harder
minimal_context: The student is in a whole class setting, expected to answer questions correctly on a task-based worksheet.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Class, please focus on answering the questions correctly on your worksheet. I am giving a verbal warning to anyone not attending to the lesson.

STUDENT: (Stops talking and sits quietly, but does not work hard on the questions.)

TUTOR: You haven't written anything. If you don't complete this, you will be disallowed from going on the school trip.

STUDENT: (Does even less work, pushing the paper away.)

TUTOR: I am telling you off in front of the class right now. You need to pick up your pen and work.

STUDENT: (Stays completely quiet and withdraws, showing their response to the teacher is at stake due to the public admonishment.)

options.A: Provide access to socially appropriate sensory stimulation by giving the student a squishy stress ball.
options.B: Put the student on report, where they have task-based goals set for each lesson.
options.C: Gradually fade support and transfer responsibility for completing the worksheet to the student.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the questions on the worksheet.
